server.why_this_commit: Master head as published. The prior_study_replication_package pinned 79739257367791e86f13dbc0bc9e7ec72917c8c8 (an ancestor of this commit), which has NO launch-time tool selection; 0cc17ce adds ONEDATA_MCP_TOOLS, the server's own allow-list, which is how every file-listing and content tool is disabled without patching. The modules and API code of the four allowed tools (files.py, spaces.py and their api/ helpers) are byte-identical to 7973925 (git diff 7973925 0cc17ce over them is empty); between the two commits the server gained opt-in OpenTelemetry in the shared REST helper (off unless OTEL_* is set; the harness sets none), a read-only-token guard, and one tool, schedule_file_replication, which is disabled here
server.install: git clone https://source.invalid/owner_1/onedata-mcp work/ref/onedata-mcp && cd work/ref/onedata-mcp && git checkout 0cc17ce1144ecc233994eb13ae28e8603be15db7 && uv sync --frozen --no-dev

disabled.query_by_metadata: returns the paths of matching files (a listing by another route)
disabled.query_harvester_index: returns indexed file paths and hits (a listing)
disabled.get_file_distribution: replication state: data-movement information, not discovery of the dataset
disabled.get_file_qos_summary: replication policy information, not discovery of the dataset
disabled.get_qos_requirement: replication policy information, not discovery of the dataset
disabled.list_space_transfers: transfer information, not discovery of the dataset
disabled.get_transfer: transfer information, not discovery of the dataset
disabled.list_user_harvesters: harvester discovery is not part of the study
disabled.get_harvester_index_schema: harvester discovery is not part of the study
disabled.list_marketplace_spaces: lists spaces of other parties; not part of the study
disabled.get_file_id: redundant: get_file_attributes and get_file_metadata accept a path
disabled.list_user_spaces: returns every space the (admin) account can see, with other parties' space names, sizes and providers: leaks outside the study and changes over the campaign, so it could not be identical across options
disabled.list_space_providers: returns internal ids; the agent is given the dataset location in the task prompt and needs no space discovery
